title: Mega Mindy and the missing cake.
lines: In the little town of Ministad, a cheerful young woman works for the police.
Mieke works with Commissioner Kramer and Officer Toby.
He has a big moustache and he thinks he is very clever.
Toby is young and a bit shy.
He is secretly in love with Mega Mindy.
Because do you know Mieke's secret?
When there is danger, she goes to her secret room.
And she turns into Mega Mindy!
She wears a red suit with a yellow cape and a mask.
And she has special magic glasses.
One Tuesday morning there is big news in Ministad.
Today is the big cake competition!
All the bakers in town are taking part.
The most beautiful and tastiest cake wins a golden cup.
The mayor will taste the cakes.
Baker Bert has made a cake with five layers.
With chocolate, strawberries and a little sugar castle on top.
It's the most beautiful cake he has ever made.
He puts the cake on a table in the big square.
But when the mayor comes to taste it, the cake is gone!
Only a few crumbs are left on the table.
Commissioner Kramer comes along with Toby and Mieke.
He looks at the table with a magnifying glass.
So someone has eaten the cake!
She runs to her secret room.
Mega Mindy flies to the square.
Mega Mindy puts on her magic glasses.
With those glasses she can see tracks that nobody else can see.
They go from the table to the edge of the square.
Little footprints, with chocolate on them.
All the way to a big old house.
That's where Mysterio lives, the villain of Ministad.
Mysterio has a black cape and a big black hat.
He always wants everything for himself.
Mega Mindy looks through the window.
There sits Mysterio at the table.
With Baker Bert's cake in front of him!
He has a big fork in his hand.
Now I'll win the golden cup!
I'll just say I baked this cake myself!
Mega Mindy flies in through the window.
Mysterio gets such a fright that he falls off his chair.
But Mega Mindy uses her superpower.
She makes a big pink bubble.
Mega Mindy brings Mysterio and the cake back to the square.
Baker Bert gets his cake back.
Only one little piece is missing.
This is the tastiest cake in the whole world!
Baker Bert wins the golden cup.
He has to do the washing-up in the bakery all week.
A little later Mieke comes along again.
Mega Mindy was here, he says dreamily.
